## 1. Verdict
Deterministic mutation of the canonical parent: byte at offset 144 (the 'e' of
"rollover", 0x65) XOR 0xff -> 0x9a — verified byte-exact by python3
(`xff3_144 == out3[:144] + bytes([out3[144]^0xff]) + out3[145:]` -> True). Name scheme
`<op><parent#>_<offset>` decodes exactly (xff = XOR 0xff, parent out3, offset 144).
Effect: the file is no longer valid UTF-8, so it exercises the Windows-1252 fallback path
of srt/encoding.rs (0x9a -> 'š' per the verified CP1252 table). Consumed by
`committed_corpus_survives` (srt_fuzz_survival.rs:56-70) which read_dir's the whole
`fixtures/fuzz/` directory (37 files — count verified) and asserts damage-cap, interval,
and cue-count invariants per file. Nothing wrong with the fixture.
